allow_instructions: Allow all read-only inspection and query commands without asking: git status, git diff, git log, git show, git branch, git rev-parse.
Allow read-only file inspection: ls, find, cat, head, tail, wc, rg, grep, read, stat, file, du, df.
Allow read-only process and port inspection: ps, ss, netstat, lsof, curl health checks against localhost.
Allow read-only Docker inspection for local development: docker ps, docker logs, docker inspect, docker exec with read-only psql SELECT queries against vozeb-pro-postgres-1.
Allow read-only database queries against the local VOZEB PRO PostgreSQL container for debugging failed generation tasks, agent runs, and generation logs.
Allow npm/pnpm/vitest/playwright test and typecheck commands that only read the workspace and report results.
Allow read-only MCP and WebFetch/WebSearch calls that retrieve documentation or inspect public pages without modifying anything.
block_instructions: Always ask before git push, git reset --hard, git clean, git checkout that discards work, or any force operation.
Always ask before docker compose down, docker rm, docker volume rm, or deleting containers or volumes.
Always ask before DROP, DELETE, TRUNCATE, or UPDATE against production or shared databases.
Always ask before modifying .env, secrets, API keys, payment config, or admin credentials.
Always ask before rm -rf, mass file deletion, or writes outside the workspace.
